name: agent-skill-catalog
input_contract: One or more explicit local roots containing SKILL.md files, plus optional scoped overrides and image metadata.
output_contract: Deterministic catalog.json and self-contained index.html with skills, plugin aggregates, families, category evidence, confidence, image evidence, invocation, and metadata-only GitHub fields.
rollback_boundary: Only the selected output directory may be overwritten; scanned roots are read-only.
network_policy: No network fetches; remote image URLs remain metadata-only.
review_notes: Review trigger, boundary, governance, and package tests before release.
